steps.text: Speak to Cassius by the pond north-west of Lumbridge to start the quest.
Speak to Gillie Groats at the cow field east of Lumbridge.
choices: Can you share what makes your cows so productive?

steps.text: Speak to Seth Groats at his farmhouse east of the River Lum.
Search the shelves in Seth's farmhouse for 'The groats principles'.
Return to Cassius with the book.
Drink the milk sample near Cassius.
Talk to Cassius after drinking the milk sample.
Speak to Duke Horacio on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
Speak to Duke Horacio on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
Speak to Gillie Groats at the cow field.
Drink the milk sample near Gillie.
Talk to Gillie Groats after drinking the milk sample.
Open the bull pen gate in the north-east corner of the cow field to fight the Bull (level 30).
Kill the Bull (level 30). Protect from Melee blocks his basic attacks (max hit 3). Dodge his ground slam ('snorts') and charge ('growls') by walking through him. Special attacks can hit over 15.
Speak to Gillie Groats after defeating the Bull.
Return to Cassius to complete the quest. You can then speak to Gillie Groats for a cow bell amulet and magic lamp (1,000 XP combat/Prayer).
